enemy.name: OpFor: Fissure
enemy.flavour_text: OpFor unit designed to emulate the corrosive nature of Originium. Originium in nature corrodes other substances, just as it eats away at biological tissue in Oripathy patients. Is coexistence with Originium possible? That is what we want to find out in these simulations.

abilities.text: When defeated, fires a poison cloud at the target that defeated it, continuously dealing Arts damage to the surroundings
